# Project Role Match

> A portable Agent Skill for analyzing project source against a target role or job description and producing a source-backed Markdown and standalone offline HTML interview report.

## Install

Install the entire inner project-role-match/ directory, including SKILL.md, bin/ and references/. Use the agent and scope specified by the user. Default to the active agent and the current project when both are clear.

For the hosted repository, run from the target project:

    npx skills add https://github.com/mby2006/project-role-match/tree/main/project-role-match --skill project-role-match --copy

For a local checkout, run from the target project:

    npx skills add "<absolute-path-to-inner-skill-directory>" --skill project-role-match --copy

Pass --agent with the requested tool ID, and repeat --agent to select multiple tools. See https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/main/docs/agents.md for IDs and directories. Use --global for user-wide installation when requested.

For an offline install, copy the inner directory into the requested tool's skill directory so the resulting path ends in project-role-match/SKILL.md. If an existing installation is present, inspect it before replacing it.

Verify the installed files with Node.js 20 or later:

    node "<installed-skill-directory>/bin/project-role-match.mjs" doctor

Report the installation path and doctor result. Installation and repository analysis are separate invocations.

## Use

Open the project and ask the agent to use project-role-match with a target role or JD. The same instruction works by pointing an agent directly at project-role-match/SKILL.md without installing it.

For chat assistants, supply that SKILL.md, the relevant project files and the role or JD. The assistant can return Markdown in chat. Node.js 20+ and command execution enable automated citation checks and report quality gates. New reports should pass `--quality strict`, which blocks missing category or analysis, fewer than three interview questions per match, and insufficient category coverage unless declared via `coverage`. With project write access, `write` saves matching .md and .html reports under .project-role-match/ in the target project root; the HTML file is standalone and works offline. It also writes a .receipt.json quality receipt recording every gate, warnings, counts, and SHA-256 hashes of both report artifacts. Run `verify --root <project-root> --receipt <receipt.json>` to recompute those hashes and detect missing, modified, or out-of-project artifacts.
